name: H.litN.aut.bc: BaseChangeIsobaricN
statement: Entire original all-rank definite-inner-form nongeneric package, including actual CsdAsc, all local/spherical/weight clauses.

name: H.litN.loc.bern: BernsteinUnitaryProductIrreducible
statement: Normalized two-factor induction of smooth irreducible unitarisable GL factors is irreducible.

name: H.litN.loc.bz: BernsteinZelevinskyFiniteness
statement: Only irreducible admissibility and the exact compact-integral normalized-induction contragredient equivalence are used here.

name: H.litN.loc.sq: SquareIntegrableSegment
statement: A unitary square-integrable GL representation is the L-segment quotient for a segment.

name: H.litN.loc.cos: StandardCosocleGL
statement: An actual ordered list LFactors has an irreducible cosocle with unique maximal kernel.

name: H.litN.aut.fin: AutomorphicFormsFiniteGL
statement: Finite-dimensionality at the actual open finite level, compact infinity coefficient type and scalar central character.

name: H.litN.aut.cusp: CuspFormsBoundedGL clause
statement: Every cusp function with norm invariant under the split real center is bounded.

name: Haar quotient measure and finite covolume of GL modulo its split center
statement: The original adelic GL group is unimodular and its latticeGL quotient has finite Haar volume; Haar uniqueness/fundamental-domain integral transport.

name: Iwasawa decomposition for original GL block coordinates
statement: G(F)=P(F)GL(O_F), and the source adelic unipotent/Levi/compact-infinity/finite factorization; the same maps and modulus are used.

name: Compact adelic additive Fourier uniqueness
statement: Standard character of A_E/E, nontrivial at each completion; Fourier coefficients detect continuous functions on finite products, and compact Haar/Fubini.

name: Highest-weight theory for compact U(n)
statement: Every finite-dimensional continuous irreducible complex U(n) representation is the original dominant-integral highest-weight representation.

name: Density theorem for simple modules with scalar endomorphisms
statement: A finite algebraic tensor of simple modules over complex algebras, each having scalar endomorphisms, is simple; coordinate separation of finite tensors.
